pairs: “Descend to the house of the king of Judah,
and there you shall speak this word.
Listen to the word of the Lord,
who sits upon the throne of David:
et liberate vi oppressum de manu calumniatoris:
and free anyone who is oppressed by violence from the hand of a false accuser.
And do not be willing to sadden the new arrival,
nor should you burden them unfairly.
et sanguinem innocentem ne effundatis in loco isto.
And you shall not shed innocent blood in this place.
Si enim facientes feceritis verbum istud,
For if you will indeed accomplish this word,
ingredientur per portas domus hujus reges sedentes de genere David super thronum ejus,
then there will enter through the gates of this house kings from the stock of David,
and riding on chariots and on horses:
Quod si non audieritis verba hæc:
But if you will not listen to these words,
quia in solitudinem erit domus hæc.
that this house will be in desolation.
Quia hæc dicit Dominus super domum regis Juda:
For thus says the Lord about the house of the king of Judah:
You are to me like Gilead, the head of Lebanon.
Certainly, I will make you desolate,
And I will sanctify over you the destroying man
And they will cut down your select cedars
and throw them violently into the fire.
Et pertransibunt gentes multæ per civitatem hanc,
And many nations will pass through this city.
And each one will say to his neighbor:
Quare fecit Dominus sic civitati huic grandi?
‘Why has the Lord acted in this way toward this great city?’
Eo quod dereliquerint pactum Domini Dei sui,
‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God,
You should not choose to weep for the dead,
nor should you mourn over them with tears.
Lament for him who is departing,
for he will return no more,
nor will he see his native land again.
Quia hæc dicit Dominus ad Sellum,
For thus says the Lord to Shallum,
qui regnavit pro Josia patre suo,
who reigned in place of his father,
qui egressus est de loco isto:
who has departed from this place:
He will not return here again.
sed in loco ad quem transtuli eum,
he will die in the place to which I have transferred him,
et terram istam non videbit amplius.
and he will not see this land anymore.
Væ qui ædificat domum suam in injustitia,
Woe to one who builds his house with injustice
et cœnacula sua non in judicio:
and his upper rooms without judgment,
who oppresses his friend without cause
et mercedem ejus non reddet ei:
and does not pay him his wages.
‘I will build a broad house for myself,
and he builds the roof out of cedar,
and he paints it with red ocher.
Numquid regnabis quoniam confers te cedro? pater tuus numquid non comedit et bibit,
Will you reign because you compare yourself to the cedar? Did your father not eat and drink,
et fecit judicium et justitiam tunc cum bene erat ei?
and act with judgment and justice, so that it would be well with him?
Judicavit causam pauperis et egeni in bonum suum:
He judged the case of the poor and the indigent for their good.
numquid non ideo quia cognovit me?
Was this not because he knew me,
Tui vero oculi et cor ad avaritiam, et ad sanguinem innocentem fundendum,
Yet truly, your eyes and your heart are toward avarice and the shedding of innocent blood,
et ad calumniam, et ad cursum mali operis.
and toward false accusations and the pursuit of evil deeds.
Propterea hæc dicit Dominus ad Joakim,
Because of this, thus says the Lord toward Jehoiakim,
king of Judah: They will not mourn for him by saying,
They will not make a noise for him and say,
He will be buried with the burial of a donkey,
putrefactus et projectus extra portas Jerusalem.
having rotted and been thrown out of the gates of Jerusalem.
et in Basan da vocem tuam:
And utter your voice in Bashan,
and cry out to those passing by.
quia contriti sunt omnes amatores tui.
For all your lovers have been crushed.
Locutus sum ad te in abundantia tua,
I spoke to you in your abundance,
hæc est via tua ab adolescentia tua,
This has been your way from your youth,
for you have not listened to my voice.
The wind will feed all your shepherds,
et amatores tui in captivitatem ibunt:
and your lovers will go into captivity.
And then you will be confounded,
et erubesces ab omni malitia tua.
and you will be ashamed of all your wickedness.
and who nest in the cedars,
quomodo congemuisti cum venissent tibi dolores,
in what way did you mourn when suffering came to you,
like the suffering of a woman giving birth?
quia si fuerit Jechonias filius Joakim regis Juda annulus in manu dextera mea,
the son of Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, were a ring on my right hand,
I would remove him from there.
et dabo te in manu quærentium animam tuam,
And I will deliver you into the hand of those who seek your life,
et in manu quorum tu formidas faciem,
and into the hand of those whose face you dread,
et in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis,
and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon,
and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
et matrem tuam quæ genuit te,
and your mother who conceived you,
in which you were not born,
Et in terram ad quam ipsi levant animam suam ut revertantur illuc,
And to the land about which they lift up their mind, thinking to return there,
Numquid vas fictile atque contritum vir iste Jechonias?
Is this man, Jeconiah, a broken earthenware vessel?
Is he a vessel which is entirely unpleasing?
quare abjecti sunt ipse et semen ejus,
Why have they been cast out, he and his offspring,
et projecti in terram quam ignoraverunt?
cast out even into a land that they have not known?
Listen to the word of the Lord!
virum qui in diebus suis non prosperabitur:
he is a man who will not prosper in his days.
nec enim erit de semine ejus vir qui sedeat super solium David,
For there will not be a man from among his offspring who will sit upon the throne of David,
et potestatem habeat ultra in Juda.
or have authority in Judah, anymore.”
